value.rationale: The piecewise quadratic integral and isolated finite-order cases in the motivating 2021 work make the global rotation invariant an immediate, natural dynamical quantity. Its closed formula resolves the entire elliptic real-parameter regime, separates dense uniquely ergodic orbits from all periodic ones, determines new infinite higher-numerator rational families and exact prime periods, and gives an exact invariant-area measure usable for orbit statistics. The qualitative conjugacy is classical but its map-specific quantitative law is not a renaming or arbitrary slice.
